search_window.basis: Start immediately after the preceding GitHub-verified completed heartbeat and end at the current review; require publication or new access impact within this window, exclude repeats.

coverage_notes.exclusion_policy: No donation drives, resource guides, recipes, promotion, opinion, generic inflation stories, routine distribution scheduling, historic events, or duplicates.
coverage_notes.assessment: No source checked substantiated a new qualifying U.S. food-access disruption during the bounded interval. All 12 targeted searches returned results and six selected direct-source opens succeeded. No evidence of a material watch failure, but index latency and limited supplementary scope mean national absence is not established.
